description: Get the NEAR Radar: what is changing on NEAR now and needs action, and nothing that has already resolved. Protocol upgrades with the validator vote and voting dates (until the network runs the new version), CODE_RED and security nearcore releases, House of Stake votes (until they close) and timelocks, HSP drafts on gov.near.org not yet on chain, NEAR security incidents (30 days), and dated events such as the hackathon deadline. Each alert has a deadline where one exists, the date it expires, who it affects and a source link. Filter by level (critical/important/ecosystem/all). Use for "what is about to change or break on NEAR", "is there a protocol upgrade", "what is House of Stake voting on".

level.description: Severity floor. "critical" and "important" return only that level; "ecosystem" is the low-severity feed; "all" (default) returns every live alert.

limit.description: How many alerts to return, most severe and most recent first. Default 25.

offset.description: Skip this many before returning, for paging past the limit. The response states the full count and echoes the offset used.

name: get_radar
